# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary
Brief description of the changes introduced by this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code cleanup
- [ ] Documentation update

## Related Issues
Closes #

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly without errors or warnings.
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`).
- [ ] Tested on Android Emulator or Physical Device.
- [ ] Verified UI styling matches the Focus Monochromatic Design System.
